facts.text: Jolene designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need.

evidence.quote: I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need.

facts.text: Jolene felt a sense of purpose and satisfaction after seeing the water purifier working and providing clean water to the community.

evidence.quote: Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying.

facts.text: Jolene aspires to continue working in engineering to create sustainable solutions that benefit communities in need.

evidence.quote: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions.

facts.text: Jolene expressed gratitude for Deborah's support and mentioned being motivated to pursue her passions.

evidence.quote: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
